title: BehaviorsPanel: attached behavior rows not persisted to document model
description: BehaviorsPanel.tsx (line 297-299) manages AttachedBehavior rows in local React useState only. On panel close/reopen the list is lost. Fix: (1) add 'behaviors?: AttachedBehavior[]' to the Frame type in packages/core/src/model/types.ts, (2) seed the panel's rows from the selected frame's behaviors on mount, (3) dispatch model updates when behaviors are added/removed/reordered, (4) define the AttachedBehavior type if not already in types.ts.
